reason: I'll assemble the mirrors first; their arrangement seems central to making a repeating pattern.

reaction: The green points and orange stars were a satisfying payoff for the assembly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the colour drum was worthwhile: leaving room for the shapes to slide explained how the pattern could change.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive housing and eyepiece fittings felt predictable and offered little to consider.

surprise.text: The mirrors reflecting one another can turn a small view into a much larger pattern.

arbitrary.text: The milky cover's exact contribution was not explained when it was fitted, although diffusing light seemed a plausible purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another mechanism: the mirror explanation and finished pattern were interesting, although the linear assembly became repetitive.
